name: WGS deletion structural variant callers benchmark
description: Provides a comprehensive comparison of whole-genome sequencing-based deletion callers, measuring sensitivity, precision, breakpoint resolution, and false-discovery characteristics.
evaluation_method: sensitivity (recall), precision, breakpoint resolution, and false discovery rate (FDR)
general_score_metric: precision and sensitivity (recall), often summarized by F1 and breakpoint-resolution measurements
reputation: Well-regarded in genomics benchmarking for comparing deletion callers, with moderate adoption among structural-variant tool developers and evaluators.
notes: Performance depends strongly on sequencing platform, depth, read length and variant size; results vary with truth-set definitions and sample choice; not an NLP/LLM benchmark.
